say:1:1029301001:1.text: "Eleray sensed the feathers on the underside of his wings faintly vibrating as he intuitively recognized a suspect..."
say:1:1029301001:1.source_cn: “电光感觉到自己翅膀下面的羽毛在微微颤抖，这是他直觉意...

choice_prompt:2:1029301001.text: "Eleray sensed the feathers on the underside of his wings faintly vibrating as he intuitively recognized a suspect..."
choice_prompt:2:1029301001.source_cn: “电光感觉到自己翅膀下面的羽毛在微微颤抖，这是他直觉意识到嫌疑人……”

say:3:1029301002:1.text: I'm reading a detective novel. I wanna know what it's like to be a detective!
say:3:1029301002:1.source_cn: 我正在看侦探小说呢，体会一下作为侦探的感觉！

say:4:1029301004:1.text: Oh—Magister! You've come back! Finally! I really missed you!
say:4:1029301004:1.source_cn: 啊——是老师！你终于回来啦，我好想你呀！
say:4:1029301004:1.male: Oh—Magister! You've come back! Finally! I really missed you!
say:4:1029301004:1.female: Oh—Magister! You've come back! Finally! I really missed you!

say:5:1029301005:1.text: Quick, tell me what you've been through since we were apart! I bet it's more exciting than any detective novel!
say:5:1029301005:1.source_cn: 快和我讲讲，之前我们分开之后，你们又遇到了什么事？一定...
say:5:1029301005:1.male: Quick, tell me what you've been through since we were apart! I bet it's more exciting than any detective novel!
say:5:1029301005:1.female: Quick, tell me what you've been through since we were apart! I bet it's more exciting than any detective novel!

narration:7:1029301006:0.text: You tell Fay about what happened...
narration:7:1029301006:0.source_cn: 向菲讲述了之前发生的一些事情……

say:9:1029301007:1.text: You're saying that Atalanta... stole the Faith Stone?! Is she really that powerful?
say:9:1029301007:1.source_cn: 你是说，是那个阿塔兰忒……偷走了圣石？！她竟然这么厉害的吗？

say:10:1029301008:1.text: Well, what I mean is... She was actually able to steal it? I thought it was well-guarded... How exactly did it happen?
say:10:1029301008:1.source_cn: 不对，我的意思是……她竟然能偷走圣石？圣石不是被保护着...

say:12:1029301009:1.text: We're not actually too clear on the details ourselves. We only know that there seems to be more than one Faith Stone...
say:12:1029301009:1.source_cn: 具体的事情，我们也不清楚。只知道圣石似乎不止一块……

say:13:1029301010:1.text: I see... If even the magister doesn't know, I bet there's some huge secret behind all this.
say:13:1029301010:1.source_cn: 原来如此……既然连老师都不知道，这件事的背后一定还藏着...
say:13:1029301010:1.male: I see... If even the magister doesn't know, I bet there's some huge secret behind all this.
say:13:1029301010:1.female: I see... If even the magister doesn't know, I bet there's some huge secret behind all this.

say:14:1029301011:1.text: Alright! It's decided! Let's go together and investigate the truth of this "Case of the Stolen Faith Stone!"
say:14:1029301011:1.source_cn: 好！决定了，我们一起去调查这个神秘的“圣石失窃案”的真相吧！

choice_prompt:15:1029301011.text: Alright! It's decided! Let's go together and investigate the truth of this "Case of the Stolen Faith Stone!"
choice_prompt:15:1029301011.source_cn: 好！决定了，我们一起去调查这个神秘的“圣石失窃案”的真相吧！

say:16:1029301012:1.text: As an associate member of the Evergreen Conservatory and a gemologist, naturally I should take on the responsibility of investigating the Faith Stone.
say:16:1029301012:1.source_cn: 作为冬青学会的编外成员和宝石研究者，我理所应当承担起调...

say:17:1029301013:1.text: And anyway... isn't this case super interesting? It's like a detective story itself, with few clues but many challenges...
say:17:1029301013:1.source_cn: 更何况……这个案件不是很有趣嘛！就像侦探小说的谜题一样...

say:18:1029301014:1.text: But no matter how complex the case, the shrewd detective will always uncover the truth in the end!
say:18:1029301014:1.source_cn: 但不管事情有多复杂，最后都会被精明的侦探找出真相！

say:19:1029301015:1.text: The first job of the Detective Fay Squad is to gather clues!
say:19:1029301015:1.source_cn: 菲侦探小队的调查第一步，收集线索！

say:20:1029301016:1.text: Hey! You just want to play detective!
say:20:1029301016:1.source_cn: 喂！你只是想玩侦探游戏吧！

choice_prompt:21:1029301016.text: Hey! You just want to play detective!
choice_prompt:21:1029301016.source_cn: 喂！你只是想玩侦探游戏吧！

say:22:1029301017:1.text: By asking other scholars? However... What the magister just said is pretty comprehensive...
say:22:1029301017:1.source_cn: 问问其他的学者？不过……老师刚刚说的信息已经很全面了……
say:22:1029301017:1.male: By asking other scholars? However... What the magister just said is pretty comprehensive...
say:22:1029301017:1.female: By asking other scholars? However... What the magister just said is pretty comprehensive...

say:23:1029301019:1.source_cn: 主人，你有什么好办法吗？

choice_prompt:24:1029301019.source_cn: 主人，你有什么好办法吗？

say:25:1029301020:1.text: Right as usual, Magister! That makes total sense! As the saying goes, "The source of things usually includes the truth of things!"
say:25:1029301020:1.source_cn: 不愧是老师！很有道理！谚语说的好，“事情的来源往往都蕴...
say:25:1029301020:1.male: Right as usual, Magister! That makes total sense! As the saying goes, "The source of things usually includes the truth of things!"
say:25:1029301020:1.female: Right as usual, Magister! That makes total sense! As the saying goes, "The source of things usually includes the truth of things!"

say:26:1029301021:1.text: What saying is that? How come I've never heard it before...?
say:26:1029301021:1.source_cn: 这是哪里的谚语？我怎么好像没听说过……

say:27:1029301022:1.text: I just came up with it! But that's not important. If we want to examine the case of the stolen Faith Stone, we'll require local intelligence!
say:27:1029301022:1.source_cn: 是我刚刚想出来的！不过这不重要啦，重要的是，我们要研究...

say:28:1029301023:1.text: In other words, our next step should be... to gather intelligence directly from the villagers!
say:28:1029301023:1.source_cn: 也就是说，我们的下一步应该是——从当地的村民们口中获取情报！

say:29:1029301024:1.text: Well, that's good in theory... But who do you want to ask?
say:29:1029301024:1.source_cn: 呃，可以倒是可以……但你要找谁问？

choice_prompt:30:1029301024.text: Well, that's good in theory... But who do you want to ask?
choice_prompt:30:1029301024.source_cn: 呃，可以倒是可以……但你要找谁问？

say:31:1029301025:1.text: Marilee, eh...? Makes sense! Her grandparents ought to be pretty familiar with the history of Holistone.
say:31:1029301025:1.source_cn: 梅瑞特是吗……好像很有道理诶！梅瑞特的爷爷奶奶应该也对...

say:32:1029301026:1.text: So get moving, Detective Fay Squad! Our destination is Marilee's house!
say:32:1029301026:1.source_cn: 那么，菲侦探小团队，出发！目的地是——梅瑞特的家！

choice:24:0:1.text: The origin of the Faith Stone.
choice:24:0:1.male: The origin of the Faith Stone.
choice:24:0:1.female: The origin of the Faith Stone.

say:34:1029301018:1.text: Any clues related to the Faith Stone, of course. But who should we ask?
say:34:1029301018:1.source_cn: 当然是和圣石有关的任何线索。但是去找谁询问呢？

say:35:1029301003:1.text: No, no! This is a detective novel. I wanna know what it's like to be a detective!
say:35:1029301003:1.source_cn: 不是啦！这可是侦探小说的情节，我正在体会作为侦探的感觉！

say:2:1029302001:1.text: Oh, look, it's Fay and her friends! Marilee's not at home. How can I help you?
say:2:1029302001:1.source_cn: 哦，是菲啊，还有这些朋友们……梅瑞特不在家。你们有什么...

say:3:1029302002:2.text: We're actually looking for you, Grandpa Rick.
say:3:1029302002:2.source_cn: 瑞克爷爷，我们是来找你的。

say:4:1029302003:1.text: Huh? Me? Not a lot I can help you with at this old age.
say:4:1029302003:1.source_cn: 啊，找我？我这一把年纪，可帮不上你们什么忙啊。

say:5:1029302004:1.text: We're currently looking into the old case of the stolen Faith Stone and wanted to ask if you knew anything about it.
say:5:1029302004:1.source_cn: 瑞克爷爷，我们正在调查圣石相关的事情，所以想问问你对于...

say:6:1029302005:1.text: The stolen Faith Stone... Oh, you mean that old rumor.
say:6:1029302005:1.source_cn: “圣石失窃案”……哦，你是说之前传言中圣石被偷走的事情吧。

say:7:1029302006:0.text: You're asking the wrong guy. I'm not originally from Holistone, I don't know much about what happened here in the past.
say:7:1029302006:0.source_cn: 这个你们还真是问错人了。我并不是圣石镇本地人，这些过去...

say:8:1029302007:0.text: However, while I may be an outlander, Mera grew up here. You could go ask her, as she knows a lot more about this place.
say:8:1029302007:0.source_cn: 不过，我是外乡人，但是小梅奶奶梅拉从小在这里长大。你们...

choice_prompt:9:1029302007.text: However, while I may be an outlander, Mera grew up here. You could go ask her, as she knows a lot more about this place.
choice_prompt:9:1029302007.source_cn: 不过，我是外乡人，但是小梅奶奶梅拉从小在这里长大。你们可以去问问她，她对这里可比我了解多了。

say:10:1029302008:1.text: She went out to pick hexaflowers. She's keen to make some special tea, and this is the perfect season for those kinds of flowers. You simply must try some...
say:10:1029302008:1.source_cn: 梅拉出去采六角葵了，她打算做些特殊的茶叶，这个季节的六...

say:11:1029302009:1.text: Oh, I'm sorry. I seem to ramble on these days. Mera should be somewhere near the flowers; go and have a look for her there.
say:11:1029302009:1.source_cn: 啊，不好意思，年纪大了，说话总有些琐碎。梅拉应该就在花...

say:0:1029303001:0.text: Look, Magister! Grandma Mera's right over there!
say:0:1029303001:0.source_cn: 老师你看，梅拉奶奶就在那里！
say:0:1029303001:0.male: Look, Magister! Grandma Mera's right over there!
say:0:1029303001:0.female: Look, Magister! Grandma Mera's right over there!

say:3:1029304001:1.text: Fay! And you're... Marilee's friends! Are you looking for her?
say:3:1029304001:1.source_cn: 菲，还有你……是小梅的魔法师朋友！你们来找小梅吗？
say:3:1029304001:1.male: Fay! And you're... Marilee's friends! Are you looking for her?
say:3:1029304001:1.female: Fay! And you're... Marilee's friends! Are you looking for her?

say:4:1029304002:1.source_cn: 不是的，梅拉奶奶，我们是来找你的！

say:5:1029304003:1.text: Oh, you're here to help? Great! I was just getting a bit anxious about how I was going to pick enough hexaflowers. Making tea requires a lot!
say:5:1029304003:1.source_cn: 哦，你们是来帮我的？太好了，我正好在犯愁怎么收集到足够...

say:6:1029304004:1.text: Why don't you help me gather the hexaflowers? And remember not to damage the leaves! Thank you so much, youngsters.
say:6:1029304004:1.source_cn: 那你们帮我收集一些花朵吧，记得千万不要损坏花瓣啊。麻烦...

say:7:1029304005:1.text: Uhh... How did we end up helping gather hexaflowers?
say:7:1029304005:1.source_cn: 呃……我们怎么突然变成来帮忙收集花瓣的人了？

say:8:1029304006:1.text: Well, actually, Grandma Mera's hearing isn't what it once was. She probably misheard...
say:8:1029304006:1.source_cn: 那个，其实梅拉奶奶的耳朵稍微有点问题，应该是听错了……

say:0:1029305001:0.text: Seeing as we need her help, we might as well lend a hand first.
say:0:1029305001:0.source_cn: 既然我们要找她帮忙，就先帮她收集六角葵吧。
say:0:1029305001:0.male: Seeing as we need her help, we might as well lend a hand first.
say:0:1029305001:0.female: Seeing as we need her help, we might as well lend a hand first.

say:1:1029305002:0.text: The magister's right. Help others first if we want their help!
say:1:1029305002:0.source_cn: 主人说得对，既然我们要找人帮忙，那就要先帮助别人才行！
say:1:1029305002:0.male: The magister's right. Help others first if we want their help!
say:1:1029305002:0.female: The magister's right. Help others first if we want their help!

say:0:1029306001:0.text: You collected enough hexaflowers so fast! Was it by magic? You've gotta teach me!
say:0:1029306001:0.source_cn: 不愧是老师，已经收集到足够的六角葵了！是使用了魔法吗？...
say:0:1029306001:0.male: You collected enough hexaflowers so fast! Was it by magic? You've gotta teach me!
say:0:1029306001:0.female: You collected enough hexaflowers so fast! Was it by magic? You've gotta teach me!

say:1:1029306002:0.text: No, something like this doesn't require magic...
say:1:1029306002:0.source_cn: 不，这种事并没有使用魔法的必要……
say:1:1029306002:0.male: No, something like this doesn't require magic...
say:1:1029306002:0.female: No, something like this doesn't require magic...

say:2:1029306003:0.text: Thank you so much, younglings. Come back with me and have the first taste!
say:2:1029306003:0.source_cn: 年轻人，太谢谢你们了。现在回我家吧，请好好品尝我的手艺！

say:4:1029307001:0.text: Grandma Mera's tea is the best ever! Even I think it's delicious, and I don't even like tea!
say:4:1029307001:0.source_cn: 梅拉奶奶泡的茶也太好喝了吧！连我这种不喜欢茶的人都觉得...

say:5:1029307002:0.text: Ah, right... Grandma Mera, we've actually come looking for you! Do you know anything about the theft of the Faith Stone?
say:5:1029307002:0.source_cn: 啊不对，梅拉奶奶，其实我们是有正事想要找你的！你知道之...

say:6:1029307003:0.text: Huh? Did you say Wraith Bone? You don't want to mess around with that sort of magic! It'll only end in tears...
say:6:1029307003:0.source_cn: 啊？你说什么“生食”？你要吃这些用来泡茶的叶片吗，那可...

say:7:1029307004:0.text: No, no, no! I said, Faith Stone! FAITH—STONE—!
say:7:1029307004:0.source_cn: 不不不不是，我是说圣石啦，圣——石——！

say:8:1029307005:1.text: Whoa, Fay's got a set of lungs on her! My ears hurt!
say:8:1029307005:1.source_cn: 呜哇，菲突然用了好大的音量，耳朵都有点不舒服了！

say:9:1029307006:1.text: Ohh, you meant the Faith Stone... Ah, well, that's a long story.
say:9:1029307006:1.source_cn: 哦哦，你说圣石啊……哎呀，那可就是个长长的故事了。

say:10:1029307007:1.text: Let me think... When I was small, I used to live near the Ruins Plaza. But later there was a disaster—an earthquake or something—and everybody had to move.
say:10:1029307007:1.source_cn: 让我想想……小时候，我家就住在遗迹广场附近。但后来那边...

say:11:1029307008:1.text: My family moved here too, and the Faith Stone was reinstalled in what is now Holistone's square. That's the origin of the town's name.
say:11:1029307008:1.source_cn: 我家也搬到了现在这里，而圣石也被安置在了现在圣石镇的广...

say:12:1029307009:0.text: The Faith Stone is simply of utmost importance to the village. The later loss of it was a terrible surprise...
say:12:1029307009:0.source_cn: 圣石对小镇来说简直太重要了，之后圣石的丢失，才这么让人...

say:13:1029307010:0.text: Actually, all I know is that someone stole the Faith Stone. I don't really know the details.
say:13:1029307010:0.source_cn: 其实，我也只知道圣石是被人被偷走的。更具体的情况我就不...

say:14:1029307011:0.text: Thank you, Grandma Mera! You've been a great help.
say:14:1029307011:0.source_cn: 谢谢梅拉奶奶！你已经帮了我们很多了。

say:15:1029307012:1.text: However, I just recalled a friend of mine who's lived in the village his whole life. He's usually hanging around the plaza, brooding on the theft of the Faith Stone...
say:15:1029307012:1.source_cn: 不过，我突然想起来，我有个朋友一直生活在镇子里。他总在...

say:18:1029307013:4.text: Who's that, then? This "friend" isn't that Richard, is it? Is that flaming lummox still in touch with you?
say:18:1029307013:4.source_cn: 什么朋友？梅拉，你说的“朋友”该不会是那个理查吧？那家...

say:19:1029307014:2.text: Huh? What's with you? He hasn't been very well recently; maybe he's sick... At our age, we need to take care of our health.
say:19:1029307014:2.source_cn: 啊？你说理查怎么了？他最近好像一直身体不好，难道是生病...

say:20:1029307015:2.source_cn: 你、你还关心他生病不生病？

say:22:1029307016:0.text: How come the mood suddenly got so tense...? I don't think this is something we should get into the middle of.
say:22:1029307016:0.source_cn: 他们……怎么突然吵起来了？感觉这不是我们能随便插话的情况……

say:23:1029307017:1.text: Let's go, Magister... We've already got what we came for, anyway, and it looks like they need time to sort out their own issues...
say:23:1029307017:1.source_cn: 老师，我们先走吧……反正该问的事情都已经问到了，他们看...
say:23:1029307017:1.male: Let's go, Magister... We've already got what we came for, anyway, and it looks like they need time to sort out their own issues...
say:23:1029307017:1.female: Let's go, Magister... We've already got what we came for, anyway, and it looks like they need time to sort out their own issues...

say:0:1029308001:0.text: Makes sense. Let's go to Holistone and look for this "Richard".
say:0:1029308001:0.source_cn: 有道理，我们先走吧，去圣石镇找找那位“理查”先生。
say:0:1029308001:0.male: Makes sense. Let's go to Holistone and look for this "Richard".
say:0:1029308001:0.female: Makes sense. Let's go to Holistone and look for this "Richard".

say:1:1029308002:0.text: So, uh... Bye, you two! See you when I'm done with my investigation!
say:1:1029308002:0.source_cn: 那个，瑞克爷爷，梅拉奶奶，再见啦！等我调查完圣石失踪案...

say:0:1029309001:0.text: Is that guy Richard? He looks so serious!
say:0:1029309001:0.source_cn: 那个人应该就是理查爷爷吗？看起来好严肃哦！

say:2:1029310001:2.text: Excuse me, are you Richard? Grandma Mera—
say:2:1029310001:2.source_cn: 那个，请问你是理查爷爷吗？梅拉奶奶——

say:3:1029310002:1.text: Did Mera send you to find me? How's she doing? And Rick... Are they both well?
say:3:1029310002:1.source_cn: 是梅拉让你们来找我的吗？她最近过得怎么样？还有瑞克……...

say:4:1029310003:1.text: They're doing great. She even made tea for us!
say:4:1029310003:1.source_cn: 他们都挺好的，梅拉奶奶还泡了茶给我们喝！

say:5:1029310004:1.text: Of course, she's always been the best cook, be it tea or cakes. But why have you come?
say:5:1029310004:1.source_cn: 梅拉的手艺，一直是很好的，不管是泡茶，还是做馅饼。不过...

say:6:1029310005:1.text: We're investigating the truth of Faith Stone's theft, and Grandma Mera said you might be able to offer some leads!
say:6:1029310005:1.source_cn: 理查爷爷，我们在调查圣石失窃案的真相，梅拉奶奶说你这里...

say:7:1029310006:1.text: Ah, the theft of the Faith Stone? You probably already know that Holistone was originally built around it. You might even say that it was the soul of the village.
say:7:1029310006:1.source_cn: 圣石失窃的事情吗？你们应该也都知道了，圣石镇原本是围绕...

say:8:1029310007:1.text: Back then, no one could have guessed it wouldn't be long before the Faith Stone embedded in the pedestal was stolen.
say:8:1029310007:1.source_cn: 那时候谁也想不到，不久之后，镶嵌在坐台上的圣石竟然会被...

say:9:1029310008:1.text: Everyone was frantic, but there was nothing they could do. They later chipped in to build this statue. May Dura watch over the Faith Stone...
say:9:1029310008:1.source_cn: 大家都很着急，也没什么办法。后来共同集资建造了这座女神...

say:10:1029310009:1.text: So even the villagers who were around back then don't really know what happened to it?
say:10:1029310009:1.source_cn: 所以圣石失窃之事，就连当时的镇民们也不知道是怎么回事吗？

say:11:1029310010:1.text: That's right. All anyone knows is that the Faith Stone disappeared overnight, with zero warning.
say:11:1029310010:1.source_cn: 没错。据我所知，圣石丢失这件事就是在一夜之间发生的，完...

say:12:1029310011:1.text: After that, the Temple folks investigated for a while, but without any results.
say:12:1029310011:1.source_cn: 圣石丢失之后，虽然圣堂的人也调查了一段时间，但也一直没...

say:13:1029310012:1.text: No trace of it and no suspects. Everything seemed to be over, just like that.
say:13:1029310012:1.source_cn: 没有圣石的消息，也没有犯人。一切就像都这么不明不白地结束了。

say:15:1029310014:1.text: ...The Faith Stone carries the entire history of this village. Without it, it's like a huge piece of our past is missing too.
say:15:1029310014:1.source_cn: ……圣石承载着镇子的全部历史。圣石不在了，就好像我们的...

say:16:1029310015:1.text: I don't know why, but all along I've believed... that the day would come when it would return to our small village.
say:16:1029310015:1.source_cn: 但不知道为什么，我始终相信……总有一天，圣石会回来的。...

say:17:1029310016:1.text: I'm sure it will! Thank you. What you've said means a lot to us!
say:17:1029310016:1.source_cn: 嗯，一定会的！谢谢你，理查爷爷，你提供的信息对我们来说...

say:0:1029311001:0.text: I've already got a bunch of leads, Magister! Detective Fay's putting the pieces together!
say:0:1029311001:0.source_cn: 老师，我们已经收集到不少线索了，菲侦探已经有头绪了！
say:0:1029311001:0.male: I've already got a bunch of leads, Magister! Detective Fay's putting the pieces together!
say:0:1029311001:0.female: I've already got a bunch of leads, Magister! Detective Fay's putting the pieces together!

say:1:1029311002:0.text: Let's go to the Traveler's Light and gather our thoughts.
say:1:1029311002:0.source_cn: 那我们去旁边的旅人灯火整理一下思路吧。
say:1:1029311002:0.male: Let's go to the Traveler's Light and gather our thoughts.
say:1:1029311002:0.female: Let's go to the Traveler's Light and gather our thoughts.

say:1:1029313001:1.text: As a meticulous detective, I must first sort through the intelligence we have.
say:1:1029313001:1.source_cn: 首先，作为一个思维缜密的名侦探，我需要先来整理一下目前...

say:2:1029313002:0.text: Thanks to the hard work of the Detective Fay Squad, we have two key clues—
say:2:1029313002:0.source_cn: 根据菲侦探小队的辛勤调查，我们已经得到了两份重要线索——

choice_prompt:3:1029313002.text: Thanks to the hard work of the Detective Fay Squad, we have two key clues—
choice_prompt:3:1029313002.source_cn: 根据菲侦探小队的辛勤调查，我们已经得到了两份重要线索——

say:4:1029313003:0.text: First! We know from previous research that the Faith Stone is a mysterious and ancient treasure.
say:4:1029313003:0.source_cn: 首先，从之前的研究记录来看，圣石是一个非常神秘且古老的宝物。

say:5:1029313004:1.text: Second! According to Grandma Mera, it's also very precious. So if you wanted to steal it... You'd have to have a lot of courage!
say:5:1029313004:1.source_cn: 其次！根据梅拉奶奶的证词来看，圣石非常珍贵。因此，想要...

choice_prompt:6:1029313004.text: Second! According to Grandma Mera, it's also very precious. So if you wanted to steal it... You'd have to have a lot of courage!
choice_prompt:6:1029313004.source_cn: 其次！根据梅拉奶奶的证词来看，圣石非常珍贵。因此，想要偷走圣石的话……一定要有一些勇气才行！

say:7:1029313005:1.text: You think so too? It's kind of amazing how much courage it would take for one to covet the Faith Stone...
say:7:1029313005:1.source_cn: 老师也这么认为吧？感觉需要足够的胆量才敢觊觎圣石呢！
say:7:1029313005:1.male: You think so too? It's kind of amazing how much courage it would take for one to covet the Faith Stone...
say:7:1029313005:1.female: You think so too? It's kind of amazing how much courage it would take for one to covet the Faith Stone...

say:8:1029313007:1.text: Finally! We know from Richard that the Faith Stone was incredibly important, especially to the people of Holistone.
say:8:1029313007:1.source_cn: 最后！根据理查先生的指证，我们知道圣石是很重要的，尤其...

say:9:1029313008:1.text: So, whoever thought to steal the Faith Stone must have some kind of special ability... Like the magister's profound magic!
say:9:1029313008:1.source_cn: 所以想要偷走圣石，一定需要一些特殊的能力……比如像老师...

say:10:1029313009:0.text: Therefore, after analyzing the above clues, Detective Fay has already reached a conclusion. The one responsible for stealing the Faith Stone is—
say:10:1029313009:0.source_cn: 那么，综合以上多重线索，菲侦探已经可以得出结论。偷走圣...

say:11:1029313010:1.source_cn: 一个胆大妄为的老年魔法师！

choice_prompt:12:1029313010.source_cn: 一个胆大妄为的老年魔法师！

say:13:1029313011:1.text: Is that so? Your expression is quite odd!
say:13:1029313011:1.source_cn: 是，是吗？老师你的表情好奇怪！
say:13:1029313011:1.male: Is that so? Your expression is quite odd!
say:13:1029313011:1.female: Is that so? Your expression is quite odd!

say:14:1029313013:1.source_cn: 我的推理难道出错了吗？

choice_prompt:15:1029313013.source_cn: 我的推理难道出错了吗？

say:16:1029313014:0.text: ...Ah, I'm sorry. I got a little excited doing detective work and totally forgot about that...
say:16:1029313014:0.source_cn: ……啊，不好意思，我好像一时激动，完全忘了这回事……
say:16:1029313014:0.male: ...Ah, I'm sorry. I got a little excited doing detective work and totally forgot about that...
say:16:1029313014:0.female: ...Ah, I'm sorry. I got a little excited doing detective work and totally forgot about that...

say:17:1029313015:0.text: But it doesn't matter! Didn't the rumor say that the Faith Stone had been split into several pieces?
say:17:1029313015:0.source_cn: 不过也没关系！之前不是说过，圣石被分成了好几块吗？

say:18:1029313016:0.text: Maybe Atalanta only stole one piece of it! And the rest of the Faith Stone must have been stolen by the "audacious, elderly mage!"
say:18:1029313016:0.source_cn: 阿塔兰忒可能只是偷走了其中的一块而已。剩下的圣石，一定...

choice_prompt:19:1029313016.text: Maybe Atalanta only stole one piece of it! And the rest of the Faith Stone must have been stolen by the "audacious, elderly mage!"
choice_prompt:19:1029313016.source_cn: 阿塔兰忒可能只是偷走了其中的一块而已。剩下的圣石，一定是被那位“胆大妄为的年长魔法师”偷走的！

say:20:1029313017:1.text: I guess that's what we have to do now...
say:20:1029313017:1.male: I guess that's what we have to do now...
say:20:1029313017:1.female: I guess that's what we have to do now...

choice:19:0:1.text: Best to ask the people involved.
choice:19:0:1.source_cn: 还是寻找当事人问问看吧
choice:19:0:1.male: Best to ask the people involved.
choice:19:0:1.female: Best to ask the people involved.

say:22:1029313018:1.text: Huh? I really thought that "audacious, elderly mage" was the key...
say:22:1029313018:1.source_cn: 诶？我以为“胆大妄为的年长魔法师”才是重点来着……
say:22:1029313018:1.male: Huh? I really thought that "audacious, elderly mage" was the key...
say:22:1029313018:1.female: Huh? I really thought that "audacious, elderly mage" was the key...

choice:19:1:2.text: Has nothing to do with that mage.
choice:19:1:2.male: Has nothing to do with that mage.
choice:19:1:2.female: Has nothing to do with that mage.

choice:15:0:1.source_cn: 你还记得犯人是阿塔兰忒吗？

choice:15:1:2.source_cn: 阿塔兰忒并不是魔法师

say:23:1029313012:1.text: You shut down my ideas so fast, Magister!
say:23:1029313012:1.source_cn: 老师表达得也太直白了！
say:23:1029313012:1.male: You shut down my ideas so fast, Magister!
say:23:1029313012:1.female: You shut down my ideas so fast, Magister!

say:24:1029313006:1.text: Hey, I'm just making a deduction!
say:24:1029313006:1.source_cn: 这只是针对事实的评价呢！
say:24:1029313006:1.male: Hey, I'm just making a deduction!
say:24:1029313006:1.female: Hey, I'm just making a deduction!

choice:6:1:2.text: Sounds like praise for the suspect.
choice:6:1:2.source_cn: 听起来是在夸奖嫌疑人
choice:6:1:2.male: Sounds like praise for the suspect.
choice:6:1:2.female: Sounds like praise for the suspect.

say:0:1029314001:0.text: Atalanta should be with Temesia, escorting the acolytes back to Holistone.
say:0:1029314001:0.source_cn: 阿塔兰忒应该跟特弥希娅一起，护送着修士们返回圣石镇。
say:0:1029314001:0.male: Atalanta should be with Temesia, escorting the acolytes back to Holistone.
say:0:1029314001:0.female: Atalanta should be with Temesia, escorting the acolytes back to Holistone.

say:2:1029314003:0.text: Don't worry, Magister! Leave it to Hamster Sir Chippy!
say:2:1029314003:0.source_cn: 主人，放心交给仓鼠骑士满满吧！
say:2:1029314003:0.male: Don't worry, Magister! Leave it to Hamster Sir Chippy!
say:2:1029314003:0.female: Don't worry, Magister! Leave it to Hamster Sir Chippy!

say:0:1029315001:0.text: Magister, it looks like Temesia and Atalanta are fighting Hypofiends!
say:0:1029315001:0.source_cn: 主人，特弥希娅和阿塔兰忒好像正在和魔物战斗！
say:0:1029315001:0.male: Magister, it looks like Temesia and Atalanta are fighting Hypofiends!
say:0:1029315001:0.female: Magister, it looks like Temesia and Atalanta are fighting Hypofiends!

say:1:1029316001:2.text: It's been a long time, Temesia! I've missed you!
say:1:1029316001:2.source_cn: 特弥希娅！好久不见，我好想你呀！

say:2:1029316002:0.text: Hi, Fay. It's been a while. May Dura bless you.
say:2:1029316002:0.source_cn: 你好，菲。好久不见，愿女神保佑你。

say:3:1029316003:0.text: I'm here too! Aren't you gonna say hello to me?
say:3:1029316003:0.source_cn: 我也在呢，你不和我打招呼吗？

say:4:1029316004:0.text: Y-You're the prime suspect in this case! As the lead detective, it's only right that I treat suspects seriously!
say:4:1029316004:0.source_cn: 你、你这可是本案的重点嫌疑人！作为侦探，我对嫌疑人态度...

say:5:1029316005:0.text: Huh? What do you mean "suspect"? I haven't stolen anything recently.
say:5:1029316005:0.source_cn: 啊，你说什么嫌疑人？我最近可没有偷什么东西。

say:6:1029316006:0.text: The Faith Stone! You're a suspect in the case of the stolen Faith Stone!
say:6:1029316006:0.source_cn: 圣石！你是圣石失窃案的嫌疑人！

say:7:1029316007:0.text: The Faith Stone? Why... are you investigating that?
say:7:1029316007:0.source_cn: 圣石？你们……调查这个做什么？

choice_prompt:8:1029316007.text: The Faith Stone? Why... are you investigating that?
choice_prompt:8:1029316007.source_cn: 圣石？你们……调查这个做什么？

say:9:1029316008:0.text: That all happened so long ago, I can barely remember it myself.
say:9:1029316008:0.source_cn: 这是太久之前的事情了，我已经忘得差不多了。

say:10:1029316009:2.text: Actually, Atalanta... I also want to know what really happened back then.
say:10:1029316009:2.source_cn: 阿塔兰忒，其实……我也想要知道当时发生了什么。

say:11:1029316010:0.text: Temesia, you... Fine. I understand. So this is what happened—
say:11:1029316010:0.source_cn: 特弥希娅，你……好吧，我明白了。事情是这样的——

narration:13:1029316011:1.text: Atalanta closed her eyes and lost herself in the memory...

choice:8:1:2.text: We want to know the truth.
choice:8:1:2.male: We want to know the truth.
choice:8:1:2.female: We want to know the truth.

say:1:1029317001:1.text: It happened so long ago. Temesia had been gravely wounded in a battle with Hypofiends and was in a critical condition.
say:1:1029317001:1.source_cn: 那已经是很久之前的事了。当时特弥希娅和魔物战斗受了重伤...

say:2:1029317002:1.text: There was nothing I could do but close my eyes and pray for her, praying for Dura's mercy.
say:2:1029317002:1.source_cn: 可我却什么都做不了，只能闭着眼睛为她祈祷，祈祷艾雅的垂怜。

say:3:1029317003:1.text: But just then... I heard someone discussing the Faith Stone.
say:3:1029317003:1.source_cn: 然后，就在那个时候……我似乎听到了有人在谈论圣石。

say:4:1029317004:1.text: I thought it had to be Dura's guidance, so I decided to take a risk and steal it.
say:4:1029317004:1.source_cn: 我想，这一定就是艾雅女神的指示吧。于是我决定孤注一掷，...

say:5:1029317005:2.text: Suspect Atalanta, do you remember who was speaking?
say:5:1029317005:2.source_cn: 嫌疑人阿塔兰忒，你还记得当时是谁在和你说话吗？

say:7:1029317006:1.text: Wow, Fay's like a proper detective...
say:7:1029317006:1.source_cn: 哇，菲完全是一副名侦探的架势啊……

say:9:1029317007:1.text: I was closing my eyes to pray at the time, and when I opened my eyes again, there was no one around me.
say:9:1029317007:1.source_cn: 当时我正在祈祷，再度睁开眼睛时，并没有看到周围有任何人存在。

say:10:1029317008:1.text: Hmm... That's absolutely something fishy there; thus, I'll make a note of it! Why, however, did you think of stealing the Faith Stone?
say:10:1029317008:1.source_cn: 嗯……这显然是一个疑点，我要记下来！不过，为什么你联想...

say:11:1029317009:1.text: If you'd been in the same dire straits, you'd have done the same thing.
say:11:1029317009:1.source_cn: 你如果经历过那种绝望，也会做出和我一样的选择的，

say:12:1029317010:1.text: The only thing I could think of was saving Temesia. I had to do something, anything, to save her.
say:12:1029317010:1.source_cn: 当时我满脑子只有一个念头，就是想要救特弥希娅。为了这个...

say:13:1029317011:1.text: But it was because I didn't know much about Faith Stone myself... Thus I dared steal it.
say:13:1029317011:1.source_cn: 不过，也是因为我本身对圣石并没有那么了解……所以才敢去偷吧。

say:14:1029317012:1.text: I understand. Please continue your testimony, Suspect Atalanta.
say:14:1029317012:1.source_cn: 明白了。嫌疑人阿塔兰忒，请你继续你的证言。

say:15:1029317013:2.text: After that, I came up with a simple plan of going to the square under the cover of the night and stealing the Faith Stone.
say:15:1029317013:2.source_cn: 在那之后，我就做了一个非常简单的计划，决定乘着天黑前往...

say:16:1029317014:1.text: I never expected that the Faith Stone could be stolen so easily... It went impossibly smoothly.
say:16:1029317014:1.source_cn: 我没想到的是，圣石竟然被我非常轻松地偷了出来……简直顺...

choice_prompt:17:1029317014.text: I never expected that the Faith Stone could be stolen so easily... It went impossibly smoothly.
choice_prompt:17:1029317014.source_cn: 我没想到的是，圣石竟然被我非常轻松地偷了出来……简直顺利得不可思议。

say:18:1029317015:1.text: Yes, too smoothly... Thinking about it, that was a little strange. It was the Faith Stone, after all...
say:18:1029317015:1.source_cn: 是的，非常顺利……这么一想，也很异常，毕竟那可是圣石啊……

say:20:1029317016:1.text: ...Why did you not tell me all this at the time, Atalanta?
say:20:1029317016:1.source_cn: ……阿塔兰忒，你当时为什么不告诉我这些呢？

say:21:1029317017:1.text: You were unconscious the whole time. How could I have possibly told you?
say:21:1029317017:1.source_cn: 你那会儿一直都昏迷不醒，我怎么可能顾得上说这些。

say:23:1029317018:1.text: Anyway, after I'd succeeded in stealing the Faith Stone, I was getting ready to leave when the incident happened.
say:23:1029317018:1.source_cn: 总之，在成功偷到圣石之后，我拿着它准备离开……就在这个...

say:24:1029317019:1.text: What incident? Don't stop at this crucial point of the story!
say:24:1029317019:1.source_cn: 发生了什么意外？你怎么在这么关键的地方停下来了！

say:25:1029317020:1.text: Isn't the great Detective Fay interrogating me? Why do you look like you're avidly listening to a fairytale instead?
say:25:1029317020:1.source_cn: 菲侦探不是说要审问我吗？怎么像个乖乖听我说故事的孩子似的？

say:26:1029317021:1.text: I-I'm not! Suspect Atalanta, please don't leave us in suspense. Keep confessing your crime!
say:26:1029317021:1.source_cn: 我、我才没有！嫌疑人阿塔兰忒，请不要卖关子，继续交代你...

say:27:1029317022:1.text: When I say incident, I mean... the Faith Stone suddenly started glowing. It was the middle of the night, and it was far too risky to move about with such a bright object.
say:27:1029317022:1.source_cn: 我说的意外，是指……圣石突然开始发光。当时还是是深夜，...

say:28:1029317023:1.text: I was so nervous that I could only wrap the Faith Stone in my clothes and pray that I wouldn't be discovered. Eventually, after walking a great distance, the stone finally dimmed.
say:28:1029317023:1.source_cn: 我很紧张，只能一路上用衣服包裹着圣石，内心祈祷着千万不...

say:29:1029317024:0.text: The split Faith Stone could also glow? Isn't that amazing... I wonder why?
say:29:1029317024:0.source_cn: 被分开的圣石还会发光？这也太神奇了吧……到底是什么原理？

choice_prompt:30:1029317024.text: The split Faith Stone could also glow? Isn't that amazing... I wonder why?
choice_prompt:30:1029317024.source_cn: 被分开得圣石还会发光？这也太神奇了吧……到底是什么原理？

say:31:1029317025:3.text: Oh! The magister must mean that time with Temesia... Of course, it's probably a response between the Faith Stones!
say:31:1029317025:3.source_cn: 啊！主人说的是特弥希娅那个时候……没错，这应该就是圣石...
say:31:1029317025:3.male: Oh! The magister must mean that time with Temesia... Of course, it's probably a response between the Faith Stones!
say:31:1029317025:3.female: Oh! The magister must mean that time with Temesia... Of course, it's probably a response between the Faith Stones!

say:32:1029317026:1.text: And then? What next? Suspect Atalanta, what happened after you went home with the stolen Faith Stone?
say:32:1029317026:1.source_cn: 然后呢，然后呢？嫌疑人阿塔兰忒，在你成功偷到圣石带回家...

say:33:1029317027:1.text: Then... I used the Faith Stone to save Temesia.
say:33:1029317027:1.source_cn: 之后……我就用这块圣石救下了特弥希娅。

say:34:1029317028:1.text: And I watched her unconscious expression change from painful to calm... To be honest, I didn't think that was a good sign. For a moment, I thought she'd left me for good...
say:34:1029317028:1.source_cn: 然后眼看着昏迷中的她表情从痛苦陷入了平静……说实话，这...

say:37:1029317030:2.text: Fortunately, Temesia's complexion quickly returned to normal, and she completely recovered in just a few days.
say:37:1029317030:2.source_cn: 幸运的是，特弥希娅的脸色很快重新变得红润起来，甚至没过...

say:38:1029317031:1.text: I remember thinking that the Faith Stone was really useful, and it must have been Dura guiding me.
say:38:1029317031:1.source_cn: 那时候我想，圣石这东西果然有用。这真的是艾雅给予我的指引吧。

say:39:1029317032:1.text: Whoa, what a touching story! I had no idea you were that kind of person!
say:39:1029317032:1.source_cn: 呜呜，这个故事怎么怪感人的！嫌疑人，没想到你原来是这样的人！

say:40:1029317033:1.text: What happened then? I bet lots of things happened afterward between you and Temesia!
say:40:1029317033:1.source_cn: 然后呢？之后应该还发生了很多很多事情吧！关于你和特弥希娅的？

say:41:1029317034:1.text: ...The rest of the story has nothing to do with the theft of the Faith Stone. I'm under no obligation to keep playing detective games with you, little girl.
say:41:1029317034:1.source_cn: ……后面的故事，就和圣石失窃无关了。我可没有义务继续配...

say:42:1029317035:1.text: Eh? But if that's the case, there's no way I can deduce the truth! You—
say:42:1029317035:1.source_cn: 诶？可只是这样的话，我还没办法推理出真相呀！你——

say:44:1029317036:3.text: Oh, no! Everyone! An acolyte's gone missing... Please, help me find him!
say:44:1029317036:3.source_cn: 不好了，各位！刚刚有一位修士失踪了……请帮忙找到他！

choice:30:0:1.source_cn: 我们也曾见过这个场景

choice:30:1:2.source_cn: 可能是圣石之间的感应

choice:17:0:1.text: You didn't run into any obstacles?
choice:17:0:1.male: You didn't run into any obstacles?
choice:17:0:1.female: You didn't run into any obstacles?

say:1:1029318001:0.text: Calm down. Tell us what happened.
say:1:1029318001:0.source_cn: 修女，请冷静下来。告诉我们，发生了什么事？

say:2:1029318002:1.text: Well, the camp's water ran out, and Geordie volunteered to fetch some. But hours passed, and he never came back...
say:2:1029318002:1.source_cn: 是这样，营地中的水用完了，盖尔迪自告奋勇去取水，但是几...

say:3:1029318003:1.text: He should have been back in no time if he was just fetching water! Now I'm worried he might have had some kind of accident...
say:3:1029318003:1.source_cn: 如果只是取水，他应该早就回来了才对！现在这样，怕是遇到...

say:4:1029318004:2.text: There are many Hypofiends around here. Geordiei might be in trouble.
say:4:1029318004:2.source_cn: 这附近有不少魔物，盖尔迪有可能陷入了危险境地。

say:5:1029318005:2.text: Could I ask you to help me find him, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>?
say:5:1029318005:2.male: Could I ask you to help me find him, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>?
say:5:1029318005:2.female: Could I ask you to help me find him, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>?

choice_prompt:6:1029318005.text: Could I ask you to help me find him, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>?
choice_prompt:6:1029318005.source_cn: <style=stress><player_name></style>大人，可否拜托你帮我们一同寻找？
choice_prompt:6:1029318005.male: Could I ask you to help me find him, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>?
choice_prompt:6:1029318005.female: Could I ask you to help me find him, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>?

say:7:1029318006:1.text: Great, let's go! As a detective, finding missing persons is part of my job!
say:7:1029318006:1.source_cn: 很好！现在出发。作为一个侦探，寻找失踪者也在我的工作范畴！

say:0:1029319001:0.text: Dura protect me! Get away from me, you creatures of shadow!
say:0:1029319001:0.source_cn: 艾雅庇佑，阴影之物，快远离我！

say:1:1029319002:0.text: Magister, the missing acolyte is surrounded by Hypofiends!
say:1:1029319002:0.source_cn: 主人，那个失踪的修士……看起来不太妙，他被魔物包围了！
say:1:1029319002:0.male: Magister, the missing acolyte is surrounded by Hypofiends!
say:1:1029319002:0.female: Magister, the missing acolyte is surrounded by Hypofiends!

say:1:1029320001:1.text: I only came to get water! I never thought I'd run into so many Hypofiends...
say:1:1029320001:1.source_cn: 我只是出来取个水，没想到会遇到这么多魔物……

say:2:1029320002:1.text: Dura above, thank you for your assistance.
say:2:1029320002:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上，感激诸位相救。

say:3:1029320003:1.text: Okay, now that it's been successfully resolved, can we keep investigating the theft of the Faith Stone? I still have many questions I intend to ask!
say:3:1029320003:1.source_cn: 好啦，既然事情已经顺利解决了，那我们是不是可以继续调查...

say:4:1029320004:1.text: I didn't agree to keep cooperating with you, girl.
say:4:1029320004:1.source_cn: 我可没答应要继续配合你啊，小姑娘。

say:6:1029320005:1.text: Everyone, I may have more knowledge than Atalanta about what happened after the Faith Stone was stolen. But right now, please allow me to escort the acolytes back to Holistone safely.
say:6:1029320005:1.source_cn: 各位，圣石失窃之后的事，比起阿塔兰忒，我或许更为了解。...

say:7:1029320006:1.text: After that, if you still wish to know more of the story... come find me in Holistone.
say:7:1029320006:1.source_cn: 在那之后，如果你们还想要了解这个故事的话……可以来圣石...

say:8:1029320007:1.source_cn: 特弥希娅，其实我可以继续——

say:9:1029320008:1.text: I'm sorry, Atalanta. I must insist on this.
say:9:1029320008:1.source_cn: 抱歉，阿塔兰忒。在这一点上，我坚持。
